verdict.rationale: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore is a first-party, shipped agent platform. Its documented capabilities are deploying agents built with any framework or model to production, observability into agent steps, and managed authentication and access control for tool connections such as MCP servers, knowledge bases, APIs and Lambda. Together these cover a managed runtime and orchestration home for agents, not just a vision. Missing for 10: in-depth developer documentation beyond product-page claims (e.g. runtime limits and orchestration APIs), and independent or hands-on corroboration that AgentCore works as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native team, agents have a managed home — first-party agent runtimes/orchestration services shipped and documented, not just a blog vision

citations.quote: Accelerate agents to production with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, the end-to-end platform to build, connect and optimize highly capable agents securely, at scale
The same code that runs on your laptop can deploy to production with security built into the platform.
When something goes wrong, you can see what steps your agent took, what it called, and where it went off track.

Your agent needs to call an MCP server, a knowledge base, an internal API, and a Lambda function in the same turn, and every connection needs to know who's calling and whether they're allowed. AgentCore helps you handle the authentication and access control
